Title: Artifact links resolve through MCP APIs
BodyPreview: Artifact links resolve only through supported MCP APIs (TODO, FR/TR/TEST, session log, triage, plans, files, commits, generated docs). Missing, unauthorized, stale, or ambiguous links produce diagnostics, not silent omission.

Title: Reviewer run records model effort identity
BodyPreview: Each reviewer execution records model, effort, agent identity, plugin/source, prompt template/version, run id, timestamps, and token/runtime metadata when available. Missing metadata is omitted with a diagnostic, never fabricated.

Title: Normalized findings and request quality

Title: Query failure modes by dimensions
BodyPreview: Query reports filter by workspace, model, effort, requesting agent, reviewer agent, target type, artifact type, severity, and category. Combined filters AND. Empty match is empty list.

Title: Default queue-and-record no auto mutation
BodyPreview: Default behavior is queue-and-record. Completing a review does not edit product files, requirements, or TODOs. Surfaces expose submit/status/get/query only.

Title: Read-only workspace validation service
BodyPreview: A read-only workspace validation service uses a versioned rule registry and a shared result contract with rule code/version, severity, entity kind, workspace identity, record IDs, evidence, remediation, run timestamp, duration, and summary

Title: Traceability and missing-AC rules
BodyPreview: Rules identify FR/TR/TEST with no AC rows, TR with no FR, FR lacking TR/TEST, TEST with no FR, and broken or duplicate mappings.

Title: TODO consistency rules
BodyPreview: Rules identify done=true with incomplete tasks, done=false with all tasks complete, completion without doneSummary, remaining vs completion contradiction, missing dependency targets, and missing referenced requirement IDs.

Title: Stale turns and non-terminal triage
BodyPreview: Turns in_progress more than 48h after authoritative timestamp (injectable UTC clock) are findings. Triage reports in live non-terminal states are findings. Override threshold is positive, at most 168h, authenticated, recorded.

Title: Surface parity and no auto-repair
BodyPreview: REST, Director, REPL, and plugin skill expose the same validation. Same rule codes, identities, severities, counts, and threshold. Never auto-repair. Director exit 1 on Error or Critical; exit 0 when empty or Warning-only.

Title: Optional wiki export JSON dump
BodyPreview: Optional --include-dump on wiki export emits versioned JSON dump of MCP tables keyed by source workspace, including TODO rows and requirement links. No-flag behavior is unchanged.

Title: add-workspace dump hydration
BodyPreview: add-workspace --dump on WorkspaceClient.CreateAsync / POST /mcpserver/workspace hydrates TODOs from dump, remaps workspace identity, rejects malformed dumps with no partial write.

Title: todo.yaml deprecation
BodyPreview: todo.yaml is deprecated as TODO source of truth. When dump and todo.yaml both exist, dump wins and a diagnostic names both. Cleanup archives to .mcpServer/archive/todo-yaml/ with evidence. Never silent delete.

Title: Configurable requirements wiki export tree
BodyPreview: Requirements wiki export must optionally discover docs/wiki.yaml in the active workspace and use it as the authoritative wiki document tree, navigation tree, optional home template, and flattened document list for GitHub and Azure wiki expo

Title: Default wiki export configuration during marker generation
BodyPreview: When MCP Server writes a workspace marker file, it must also create a default docs/wiki.yaml if the workspace does not already provide one, so wiki export has an explicit document tree for future GitHub and Azure exports.

Title: Reliable plugin session-log dialog parsing
BodyPreview: Official McpServer plugins SHALL parse documented dialogItems and dialog payloads, preserve every item, and reject empty or unparseable appendDialog input instead of reporting a successful no-op.

Title: Hostile review request schema and storage
BodyPreview: Persist ReviewRequest and QueueItem in EF with three-provider migrations. Reject serialized request JSON over 1048576 bytes before insert. Enforce workspace isolation on submit.

Title: Hostile review artifact resolver
BodyPreview: Resolver calls supported MCP APIs only. Diagnostics are stored on the request. Successful resolve stores identity and hash when available.

Title: Hostile review execution capture
BodyPreview: ReviewExecution entity stores model string, effort, agent, plugin/source, template id/version, run id, start/end UTC. Token counts are optional and must not be invented.

Title: Findings taxonomy and request-quality schema
BodyPreview: Finding.category is an enum of the seven classes. Verdict is AGREE|DISAGREE|UNKNOWN. RequestQualityAssessment has five explicit numeric or ordinal fields.

Title: Hostile review query indexes
BodyPreview: Query API applies AND across provided dimensions and returns empty list on no match, not an error.

Title: No auto-mutation and surface parity
BodyPreview: No apply/repair endpoint is registered. REST, REPL, Director, and plugin skill expose the four verbs only and do not write product files from verdicts.

Title: Validation registry and result contract
BodyPreview: IWorkspaceValidationService returns a DTO with the required fields. Unknown rule codes emit diagnostics. Clean workspace returns zero findings.

Title: Traceability rule implementations
BodyPreview: Each rule emits a finding with record id and evidence. TEST exclusion only if a documented rule says so.

Title: TODO consistency rule implementations
BodyPreview: Each mismatch emits a finding with the TODO id and evidence of the contradicting fields.

Title: Stale-turn clock and triage domain enum
BodyPreview: IUtcClock is injectable. Threshold default 48h. Triage states come from the live domain model. Auth, cancellation, and pagination are enforced.

Title: Hygiene surface adapters and Director exit codes
BodyPreview: Four surfaces call the same service. Director maps Error/Critical to exit 1 and Warning-only to exit 0. JSON always written. No repair methods.

Title: Dump schema and export flag
BodyPreview: schemaVersion mcp-wiki-dump/v1. SHA-256 per table plus root hash. Flag default off. tables[] uses McpDbContext DbSet names.

Title: Import remap and dump parameter binding
BodyPreview: Bind --dump to WorkspaceController.CreateAsync. Remap workspace id, paths, FKs. Idempotent re-import. Reject malformed dump, version mismatch, missing tables, unsafe path.

Title: todo.yaml archive and conflict diagnostics
BodyPreview: Discovery classifies generated/shadow/deprecated. Archive is copy then optional remove with report. Conflict diagnostic includes both paths.

Title: Dictionary-safe plugin dialog parsing
BodyPreview: The canonical PowerShell plugin core SHALL read dialogItems and dialog from IDictionary and property-backed parameter objects and SHALL fail closed when no dialog items are parsed.
